backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for an NFT platform managing collections, NFT items, user profiles, and minted tokens using Maps; includes access control via admin/user permissions and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting a single feature requirement to ensure the hardcoded fallback admin principal and console.log diagnostics are correctly implemented in the useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout frontend hook.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components, pages, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, primary, sidebar, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Istvan Seidel light art portfolio app, setting German language, viewport meta, page title/description, and mounting the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application component that configures TanStack Router with all routes (gallery, artwork, upload, contact, blog, NFT gallery/detail, admin) wrapped in a dark-mode ThemeProvider and Layout.
frontend/src/components/ActorErrorBanner: Alert banner component displayed when the backend actor fails to initialize, showing an error message and a retry button that triggers a full page reload.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionF: Form component for creating or editing NFT collections in the admin dashboard, using useCreateCollection and useUpdateCollection mutation hooks with German-language toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/AdminCollectionL: Displays a list of all NFT collections with edit (via dialog) and delete (via alert dialog) actions, showing loading skeletons and empty state as needed.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing an NFT, handling image upload with progress, collection selection, price input, and submission via create/update mutations.
frontend/src/components/AdminNFTList.tsx: Renders a list of all NFTs with thumbnail, collection name, price badge, and per-item edit/delete actions including a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/ArtworkCard.tsx: Displays a single legacy artwork as a card with an image, title, and description, including hover scale and overlay animations.
frontend/src/components/BackendStatusInd: Small badge component that shows backend connectivity status (checking, online, or unreachable) based on a health check hook.
frontend/src/components/IssuedNFTCard.ts: Card component for a minted on-chain NFT showing its image, title, description, mint date, token ID, and truncated owner principal, with an optional 'my NFT' highlight.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout providing a sticky header with logo, navigation, and login button, an optional actor error banner, a main content slot, and a footer with backend status.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing a spinner during authentication and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/MintNFTModal.tsx: A modal dialog component for minting NFTs on ICP, handling image upload (with drag-and-drop), title/description input, upload progress, and success/error states.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Top-level navigation bar component that renders nav links, conditionally shows an Admin link only after backend confirms admin status, and provides a retry button on connection failure.
frontend/src/components/NFTBadge.tsx: A small badge component that displays a sparkle icon and 'NFT' label using the primary color scheme.
frontend/src/components/NFTCard.tsx: A card component that displays an individual NFT's image, title, collection name, price, and an optional ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionCar: A clickable card component that displays an NFT collection's image, title, and description, linking to its Getgems marketplace trade URL.
frontend/src/components/NFTCollectionsSe: A section component that renders a static grid of seven predefined NFT collections (Getgems/TON) using NFTCollectionCard, with a heading and description.
frontend/src/components/NFTDetailModal.t: A detail modal that shows a full NFT's image, metadata (title, description, token ID, mint date, owner, price), and provides copy-to-clipboard fields and an ICP Explorer link.
frontend/src/components/NFTExplanation.t: An informational section component with cards explaining NFT concepts, automatic minting on ICP, and the ICP architecture to educate users.
frontend/src/components/NFTInfo.tsx: React component that displays NFT metadata (token ID, mint date, price) and a link to the ICP Explorer, with helper functions to format timestamps and ICP prices.
frontend/src/components/PrincipalDisplay: Reusable component that displays an ICP principal address (optionally shortened), shows the full value in a tooltip, and provides a copy-to-clipboard button with toast feedback.
frontend/src/data/lightHealthBlogPosts.t: Defines a StaticBlogPost interface and exports an array of static blog posts about light health topics (blue light, red light, wavelengths) with hardcoded content and nanosecond timestamps.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, initializing access control with an optional admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts: Hook that exposes a boolean indicating whether the backend actor is fully initialized, and sets an error state if the actor fails to become ready within a 20-second timeout.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendHealthCheck: React Query hook that pings the backend by calling getAllCollections() and returns the query status, re-checking every 60 seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateBlogPost.ts: Stub mutation hook for blog post creation that always throws an error, indicating the feature has been removed in favor of the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCollection.t: Mutation hook that calls the backend addCollection method and invalidates collection query caches on success, with authorization error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateNFT.ts: Mutation hook that creates an NFT via the backend actor, then fetches and returns the newly created NFT item, invalidating the nft-items cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteCollection.t: Mutation hook that deletes a collection by ID via the backend actor and invalidates both collection and NFT item caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeleteNFT.ts: Mutation hook that deletes an NFT by ID via the backend actor and invalidates the nft-items query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllArtworks.ts: Legacy hook stub that returns an empty array for artworks, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllBlogPosts.ts: Legacy hook stub that returns an empty array for backend blog posts, as the blog backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
React Query hook that fetches all NFT collections from the backend actor, combining actor loading state with query loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllIssuedNFTs.t: React Query hook that fetches all issued NFTs via the backend's listAllNFTs method, enabled only when the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllNFTs.ts: React Query hook that fetches all NFT items via the backend's getAllNFTs method, enabled only when the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtwork.ts: Legacy hook that always returns null, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetArtworksByCateg: Legacy hook that always returns an empty array, as the old artwork backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetBlogPost.ts: Legacy hook that always returns null, as the old blog backend has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: React Query hook that fetches the authenticated caller's user profile from the backend actor, only running when the user is authenticated and the actor is ready.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetMyIssuedNFTs.ts: React Query hook that fetches the list of NFTs minted by the currently authenticated user via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFT.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single NFT item by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetNFTsByCollectio: React Query hook that fetches all NFT items belonging to a specific collection from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and status tracking via DFINITY's AuthClient, exposed through a React context provider and hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdmin.ts: React Query hook that checks whether the authenticated caller has admin permissions by calling the backend actor's isCallerAdmin method.
frontend/src/hooks/useIsCallerAdminWithT: Hook that checks admin status with a hardcoded principal shortcut and a backend fallback, tracking phase state (initializing, checking, confirmed, denied, timeout, etc.) with a configurable timeout.
frontend/src/hooks/useMintNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that mints a new NFT via the backend actor and invalidates related NFT query caches on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook that saves the caller's user profile to the backend actor and invalidates the current user profile cache on success.
Stub mutation hook that always throws an error indicating the contact form feature is unavailable after the backend migration to the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateCollection.t: React Query mutation hook that updates a collection's name and description via the backend actor and invalidates the collections cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateNFT.ts: React Query mutation hook that updates an NFT's metadata and image via the backend actor and invalidates the NFT items cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadArtwork.ts: Stub mutation hook that always throws an error indicating the artwork upload feature has been replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/hooks/useUploadImage.ts: Hook that handles image file validation, upload progress tracking, and uploading to the backend actor, returning the resulting ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, configures Tailwind CSS, and defines a warm OKLCH-based CSS custom property palette for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page that checks caller admin status with timeout phases and renders tabs for managing NFT collections and NFT items.
frontend/src/pages/ArtworkDetail.tsx: Placeholder artwork detail page that displays a 'not found' message since the old artwork backend was replaced by the NFT system.
frontend/src/pages/Blog.tsx: Blog listing page that merges static and backend blog posts, displaying them as clickable cards with admin controls for creating new posts.
frontend/src/pages/BlogCreate.tsx: Admin-only form page for creating new blog posts with title, content, and optional featured image upload.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPost.tsx: Individual blog post detail page that resolves a post by ID from either static data or the backend and renders its content and featured image.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact form page with name, email, subject, and message fields that submits via the useSubmitContactForm hook and shows success/error feedback.
frontend/src/pages/Gallery.tsx: Gallery page featuring a hero banner, a quote, NFT collections section, NFT explanation, and a CTA link to the NFT gallery.
frontend/src/pages/NFTDetail.tsx: Detail page for a single NFT, fetching NFT and collection data by ID from URL params and displaying image, metadata, price, and on-chain explorer link with loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/NFTGallery.tsx: Gallery page showing all NFTs and issued NFTs with collection filtering, mint modal, detail modal, and wallet/login UI for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/Upload.tsx: Upload page allowing authenticated users to create a new NFT by filling out a form with title, description, price, collection, and image file, then minting it via the backend.
frontend/src/utils/blogHelpers.ts: Utility functions for merging static and backend blog posts into a unified sorted list, finding a post by ID, and formatting timestamps as German-locale dates.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Async utility that copies a string to the clipboard using the Clipboard API with a fallback to execCommand for older browsers.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Utility functions to shorten or format an ICP principal string for display, truncating the middle with ellipsis.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations, plus typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of a Web3/NFT project including known bugs, architectural notes, existing features, and version history. The critical open issue is that live-site admin access is denied because the backend canister does not recognize the admin's Internet Identity principal.
